CREATE TABLE "public"."Booking" (
  "adminNotes" text,
  "agreedListingTitle" text NOT NULL,
  "cancellationReason" text,
  "cancelledAt" timestamptz,
  "cancelledBy" text,
  "checkIn" date NOT NULL,
  "checkOut" date NOT NULL,
  "checkoutSessionId" text,
  "cleaningFeeCents" int8 NOT NULL,
  "couponCode" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'USD' NOT NULL,
  "discountCents" int8 NOT NULL,
  "extraGuestFeeCents" int8 NOT NULL,
  "guestEmail" text NOT NULL,
  "guestName" text NOT NULL,
  "guestNotes" text,
  "guestPhone" text,
  "guests" int4,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "listingId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "nights" int4 NOT NULL,
  "paymentReference" text,
  "paymentReviewRequired" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "petFeeCents" int8 NOT NULL,
  "pricePerNightCents" int8 NOT NULL,
  "pricingReviewRequired" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "pricingSnapshot" jsonb,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "taxCents" int8 NOT NULL,
  "totalAmountCents" int8 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "booking_amounts_nonnegative_7fdc2176" CHECK ("pricePerNightCents" >= 0 AND "cleaningFeeCents" >= 0 AND "petFeeCents" >= 0 AND "extraGuestFeeCents" >= 0 AND "discountCents" >= 0 AND "taxCents" >= 0 AND "totalAmountCents" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "booking_currency_usd_261bd47b" CHECK (currency = 'USD'),
  CONSTRAINT "booking_guest_fields_nonempty_16c46ccc" CHECK ("guestName" <> '' AND "guestEmail" <> '' AND "agreedListingTitle" <> ''),
  CONSTRAINT "booking_guests_positive_b4d03f1a" CHECK ("guests" IS NULL OR "guests" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "booking_pricing_review_consistent_87ed60fc" CHECK (("pricingSnapshot" IS NULL) = "pricingReviewRequired"),
  CONSTRAINT "booking_status_valid_c9b680e8" CHECK (status IN ('pending_payment', 'confirmed', 'cancelled')),
  CONSTRAINT "booking_stay_valid_2d172355" CHECK (nights > 0 AND "checkIn" < "checkOut"),
  CONSTRAINT "booking_version_positive_341aaa74" CHECK (version > 0)
)
